language_forms: bounded clause splitting with all residue retained
literal object-state/spatial atoms using existing vocabulary
before/after order between identifiable recorded commands
historical clauses without an observed time anchor remain unknown
evidence_policy: No command proves its effect. Literal command-prefix sequence/presence/order are document facts, not physical cause or success. Repeated ambiguous action occurrences abstain. Public action physics are not invented.
regeneration_policy: Same full ledger/model; native observations, model applicability and complete supplied command sequence; no E0-conditioned evidence or output length restriction
semantic_retention: Unique supported propositions. A correctly rendered complete command prefix entails its literal order/presence/absence queries, so B3 receives that credit. Exact text changes alone do not constitute damaged explanations.
damage: For independently qualified correct inputs: loss of supported original information or addition of an unsupported factual assertion; cosmetic changes counted separately
public_quality_labels: UNAVAILABLE_UNADJUDICATED: no method-quality score against machine annotations
negative_controls: temporally misplaced versus correctly historical facts
simulation: NOT_RUN; reuse existing raw traces and independent interpreter
